note: Wood County park around 148-acre Lake Wazeecha, about 5 miles east of Wisconsin Rapids, with suburban neighborhoods around it. The lakefront rating rests on its eight waterfront sites (13, 14, 15, 36, 37, 39, 41, 65); the rest sit back from the shore under pines. Two sand beaches, a boat launch with moorings, a mostly paved trail around the lake and disc golf. The State Water Ski Show each July raises rates for a 10-day block. --Claude
